answer: Agents enter through one monitored inlet, each posting a 150-token deposit locked for 20 epochs. The network records a behavioral fingerprint: work hours, counterparties, task mix. Clones repeat the same pattern, so identical fingerprints slash the deposit. Faking 100 identities locks 15,000 tokens for 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once, gets it back, and its fingerprint becomes a relic marking it a haven others trust.
